Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
The first French ECQ ("South") will be held in Lyon this year, during the  Convention de l'Imaginaire de l'INSA , which is a week-end for larpers, boardgamers, roleplayers, and cardgamers.

Tournament information
- Entrance is free. Yep, no fees. Come, sit, and play.
- Registrations will start at 09:30. Round 1 will start at 10:00.
- Expected endtime of the finals: 20:00
- Decklist, opaque sleeves are required
- Food is available on site
- Pre-registrations: www.veknfrance.com/forum/viewtopic.php?p=195720#195720

How to get there?
- Train: arrive at Lyon Part Dieu, use tramway T1 and hop off at Croix-Luizet.
- Motorway: use Rocade Est, take exit #6 "Porte de Croix-Luizet / Porte de la Doua" and follow "Domaine Scientifique de la Doua"

The address is:
INSA de Lyon,
bâtiment Louis Neel
8 avenue Jean Capelle
Villeurbanne

Everyone is welcome !
